responsibility: This header defines the core ltrans_partition data structure and declares the partitioning APIs used by WPA and non-WPA LTO flows. It exposes the partition vector plus the mapping, cleanup, and static-promotion routines that turn the merged symbol table into LTRANS work units and make symbol visibility safe across those partitions.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the interface for partitioning by defining struct ltrans_partition_def and declaring mapping/promotion routines; unlike gcc/lto/lto-partition.cc, it does not implement the partition-placement and boundary computation logic.
